items.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued November 6 at 12:22AM CST until November 6 at 6:00AM CST by NWS Mobile AL
items.description:
* WHAT...Visibility one quarter mile or less in dense fog.

* WHERE...Portions of south central Alabama and northwest Florida.

* WHEN...Until 6 AM CST early this morning.

* IMPACTS...Low visibility could make driving conditions hazardous.
items.instruction:
If driving, slow down, use your headlights, and leave plenty of
distance ahead of you.
